description: This file defines the Excel_Workbook class which extends the writeexcel_workbook class to handle Excel workbook creation and output, including setting HTTP headers for file download.

classes.name: Excel_Workbook
classes.description: A class for creating Excel workbooks, extending the writeexcel_workbook class. It includes methods for constructing a workbook and sending HTTP headers for file download.

methods.name: Excel_Workbook
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the workbook, optionally with a filename.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Method to output HTTP headers necessary for serving the Excel file to the browser.
